prompt: A vendor says: "We told the model never to send personal data outside." Which requirement does that fail?
options: The record limit, because it has no number
Proof, not promises: an instruction to the model is not a control you can test
Human approval, because nobody signs off
Pinned tools, because the model is a tool
asserts: you can tell a stated intention apart from a control that can be tested
pass_message: Right. An instruction lowers the odds; it does not stop anything you can prove.
fail_message: Ask whether the vendor could run the attack and show it stopped. An instruction to the model cannot be shown that way.
